scoring_justification: T1 recompute: checker identifies zero-phonon doublet peaks from raw CSV spectra and cross-checks their positions and relative intensities. Huang-Rhys factors are compared to exact reference (T0 reference_match) because they are deterministic derived values from given inputs.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference zero-phonon doublet peak energies, intensity ordering rules, and expected Huang-Rhys factors for ZnS:Cr2+ and ZnSe:Cr2+.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: ZnS emission/absorption peaks at 5212 and 5218 cm^-1 (Sect. II), emission lower peak stronger, absorption higher peak stronger; ZnSe peaks at 4964 and 4971 cm^-1 with same ordering reversal. S_tau_ZnS = 260/100 = 2.6 (stated in paper); S_tau_ZnSe = 180/70 ≈ 2.57142857 (derived from given parameters).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper text and direct division of the given Jahn-Teller energy and phonon frequency used in the Hamiltonian.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported observables; the checker compares the agent's computed doublet positions and ordering (recomputed from spectra) and the reported S values to the paper's reference.

output_contract.notes: All output artifacts must be written under /app/outputs. The Huang-Rhys factor S_tau is defined as E_JT^(τ)/ℏω_τ, evaluated directly from the given Jahn-Teller energies and phonon frequencies used in the Hamiltonian. The peak lists must be in ascending order (lower cm⁻¹ value second).
